title: HB1600 (2020 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2020/bills/HB1600_.HTM; sha256 9c3374c26ea500d24fea9a4830fa99ba86e352ec150263cde54999f002283fbe)
provenance.note: Introduced text. The bill strikes the old subsections allowing rifle/shotgun loans for 15 or 75 days without a permit and the bar on lending to prohibited persons; those are in struck brackets and not quoted. The assault pistol sentence is existing law relettered to subsection (d); SECTION 3 (HRS 134-8(a)) only updates a cross-reference. No passage vote is recorded in the data; the text read is the bill as filed.

operative_text:
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-4): No person shall transfer the possession or ownership of any firearm to any person except as expressly authorized by this chapter.
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-4): After July 1, 1992, no person shall bring or cause to be brought into the State an assault pistol.
